answer: A sybil attacker must acquire real timber for thousands of fake identities, and any gale of duplicate registrations triggers slashing of the bonded stake, making mass forgery economically ruinous. Require every agent to stake timber harvested from a verifiable physical provenance chain, then run a kernel-level identity check binding each stake to one hardware root of trust. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
